title: Active Learning Label Attestation
description: Sprint Φ-D-AL Completion — strict JSON schema for an AlLabelAttestation, one per gold label. The canonical_bytes() function in scripts/active_learning/replay_label_chain.py iterates CANONICAL_FIELDS in this exact order and dumps with sort_keys=True. Cf. docs/EFE_ACTIVE_LEARNING_COMPLETION_ARCHITECTURE.md § 12.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier (= D-AL-7 strict isolation key)

label_id.description: Unique label identifier within tenant scope

query_hash.description: SHA-256 of the input query (= 64 hex chars)

source.description: Provenance of the label (= D-AL-4 auditable lineage)

consent_hash.description: SHA-256 of (tenant_id || consent_version || epoch). Must NOT be all zeros.

cost_usd_micros.description: Per-label cost in micro-USD. D-AL-9 enforces ≤ 10 000 (= $0.01)

prev_hash.description: Previous attestation's hmac_sha256 ; first record uses 64 zeros

hmac_sha256.description: HMAC-SHA256 over canonical_bytes(attestation). NOT in canonical input.
